newsitem.title: GREECE: LIANI, STAI, ALAFOUZOS, VGONZTAS WILL NOT TESTIFY.
newsitem.headline: LIANI, STAI, ALAFOUZOS, VGONZTAS WILL NOT TESTIFY.

text.p: Dimitra Liani-Papandreou, Elli Stai, Yannis Alafouzos and Antonis Vgontzas will not testify before the parliamentary committee investigating the award of a licence to operate a new Athens casino at Flisvos, parliament officials told Reuters.

The investigating committee rejected a proposal by deputies of the conservative New Democracy party to call Liani, wife of late Prime Minister Andreas Papandreou, TV anchorwoman Stai, Alafouzos of Sky TV and Vgontzas, currently general secretary of major public works.
The rejection prompted New Democracy deputies to say there was a concerted cover up effort on the part of the socialist PASOK party and vowed to re-examine their participation in the committee.

But the committee decided to call National Economy Minister Yannos Papandoniou, Interior Minister Alexandros Papadopoulos and former conservative National Economy Minister Stefanos Manos to testify on the case.

The Flisvos casino licence was revoked by the socialist government under Prime Minister Costas Simitis in April. A U.S. investor in the cancelled casino is suing the Greek government in a U.S. court. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
